title: Security advisory flood
summary: Simulate several coordinated vulnerability reports arriving during normal delivery work.

trigger.description: The project receives more triage work than its documented responders can absorb.

assumptions: A response policy can separate public communication from private triage.
Severity labels are reviewed rather than inferred from issue titles.

inputs.name: security_contacts
inputs.description: Documented private disclosure and escalation contacts.

score.formula: weighted response coverage and tested handoff signals, bounded to 0..100

recovery_actions: Rehearse private disclosure intake and backup ownership.
Prepare a communication template that avoids exposing unverified claims.
limitations: Does not assess vulnerability severity or discover security bugs.
Does not contact reporters or publish advisories.
